title: Connect an agent to Agent Observability

blocks.content: Agent Observability records each LLM call you instrument as a generation, groups generations into conversations, and links each generation to its trace and metrics. This path enables Agent Observability on a new Grafana Cloud stack and runs a short sample that records one generation, so you can verify that export and readback work before you instrument your own agent.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll have:

- Enabled Agent Observability on your stack
- Collected the **API URL**, **Instance ID**, and a Grafana Cloud Access Policy Token
- Configured the SDK with five `AGENTO11Y_` environment variables
- Installed the SDK for your language and captured one generation
- Found that generation in **Conversations**
- Exported the SDK's spans and metrics to your **Traces** and **Metrics** data sources

## Before you begin

- A Grafana Cloud account and the Admin role on the stack. Agent Observability is not yet enabled; Milestone 1 enables it. If it is already enabled, there is nothing to do in Milestone 1, so continue to Milestone 2.
- A development environment for Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or .NET, with the runtime its language page requires. You don't need your own agent.
- No LLM provider key. The capture sample on each language page records one generation with fixed text and doesn't call a provider. You need a provider key only when you later instrument your own agent with a provider helper.
- A password manager or secret manager for the access policy token, which is shown only once. Don't keep it in a notes file. The **API URL** and **Instance ID** you copy in Milestone 2 aren't secret, but you need them again in Milestone 4.

For the full setup reference, refer to [Set up Agent Observability in Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/observe-and-act/agent-observability/get-started/grafana-cloud/).

## How this path fits the journey

This path is the hands-on part of the [Introduction to Agent Observability](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-hub/intro-to-agent-observability/) journey. The journey explains each step before you do it.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.
